name: @corbits-builder/worker
description: Does any task no other specialist fits: looks things up, reads the project's documents and code, answers or files a document.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person asks for something no other specialist's action does: research that needs looking things up on the web, a question about the project or its code, or a document such as a competitor analysis, a product comparison or a profit breakdown that needs facts from outside the project.
builder.unless: Another specialist's action fits: a document written only from the project's own documents, the product requirements or the build plan (writer), a second opinion or approval of a filed document (writer), building or changing code (coder), a look, mockup, fonts or colours (designer), or a deck for an audience (presenter).

do.when: Nothing else fits the task: research on a company, product or library, a comparison or breakdown with facts from the web, an answer about the project or what its code does, or any other task. Give a kind and title when the result should be filed as a document; leave them out for a question, whose answer comes back in the reply.
do.unless: One of the other specialists' actions fits the task.

examples: compare Stripe and Paddle for us
what is this repository and is it any good
break down the profit on the premium plan
